episodes.title: The Beautiful Lady
episodes.description: Children are vanishing at night, and they all describe the same lady in white.

scenes.narration: Last time, Lucy died, but Van Helsing feared it was not the end.
scenes.visual: A white marble tomb in a misty London churchyard

scenes.narration: Days later, London newspapers report a strange mystery.
scenes.visual: A Victorian newspaper being read under a gas lamp

scenes.narration: Children in Hampstead are vanishing at night and found at dawn.
scenes.visual: Children playing at the edge of a heath at twilight

scenes.narration: Each one has tiny wounds on the throat.
scenes.visual: A worried mother holding a sleepy child with a bandaged neck

scenes.narration: They all say a beautiful lady in white led them away.
scenes.visual: A small child pointing toward misty woods, a faint white figure among the trees

scenes.narration: Van Helsing takes Seward to Lucy's tomb at night.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing and Seward with a lantern at a stone tomb door at night

scenes.narration: They open her coffin. It is empty.
scenes.visual: An open empty coffin in a crypt, lantern light

scenes.narration: They wait in the graveyard until a white figure appears in the fog.
scenes.visual: Two men hiding behind gravestones as a white figure drifts through fog

scenes.narration: It is Lucy, carrying a sleeping child.
scenes.visual: Lucy in a white burial gown carrying a child through a misty graveyard

scenes.narration: And her lips are red with blood.
scenes.visual: Close-up of Lucy's pale face with blood-red lips and cold eyes

episodes.title: The Hardest Goodbye
episodes.description: Arthur must free the woman he loves from the curse.

scenes.narration: Last time, they saw Lucy, now undead, hunting children.
scenes.visual: Lucy's silhouette in white among gravestones

scenes.narration: Van Helsing brings Arthur and Quincey to the tomb at midnight.
scenes.visual: Men with lanterns at a churchyard gate at midnight

scenes.narration: Lucy appears and calls to Arthur, arms open, in that same sweet voice.
scenes.visual: Lucy in white, arms outstretched, smiling coldly by the tomb door

scenes.narration: Van Helsing raises a crucifix, and she shrinks back, snarling.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing raising a golden crucifix as Lucy snarls and recoils

scenes.narration: She cannot enter her tomb, because its door is sealed with holy bread.
scenes.visual: Lucy hissing at a tomb door sealed with white paste

scenes.narration: The next day, they find her asleep in her coffin.
scenes.visual: Lucy lying in her coffin, flushed and beautiful, lit by lanterns

scenes.narration: Arthur must do it himself.
scenes.visual: Arthur holding a wooden stake and a hammer, hands shaking

scenes.narration: With one blow, he drives the stake through her heart.
scenes.visual: Silhouette of a raised hammer above a coffin in a dark crypt

scenes.narration: Her face softens, and she is Lucy again, at peace.
scenes.visual: Lucy's face serene and gentle in her coffin, warm light

scenes.narration: Then the four men swear to destroy the Count.
scenes.visual: Four men clasping hands in a candlelit crypt

episodes.title: The Hunters Gather
episodes.description: The hunters piece together the Count's plan, and Mina starts to change.

scenes.narration: Last time, Arthur freed Lucy, and the men swore revenge.
scenes.visual: Four men walking out of a churchyard at dawn

scenes.narration: Jonathan and Mina return to England and join the hunters.
scenes.visual: Jonathan and Mina arriving at a Victorian house, greeted by Van Helsing

scenes.narration: In London, Jonathan glimpses the Count in the street, looking years younger.
scenes.visual: Jonathan frozen in shock on a busy London street, a tall dark figure in a top hat in the crowd

scenes.narration: Mina types every diary and letter into one complete record.
scenes.visual: Mina at a typewriter surrounded by diaries and letters

scenes.narration: Together, they finally see the Count's plan.
scenes.visual: The group gathered around a table covered in papers and a map of London

scenes.narration: He brought fifty boxes of his native earth to England.
scenes.visual: Rows of wooden crates in a dark cellar

scenes.narration: He must rest in them by day, and he has hidden them across London.
scenes.visual: A map of London marked with pins and small drawings of crates

scenes.narration: Destroy the boxes, and he will have nowhere left to hide.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing tapping the map with his finger, eyes fierce

scenes.narration: To protect Mina, the men leave her out of the hunt.
scenes.visual: Mina standing alone in a doorway as the men leave with lanterns

scenes.narration: But Mina is waking pale and tired, with no idea why.
scenes.visual: Mina waking in bed at dawn, pale, touching her throat

episodes.title: The House of Rats
episodes.description: The hunters raid the Count's lair, and Renfield pays the price.

scenes.narration: Last time, the hunters learned the Count hides in boxes of earth.
scenes.visual: Wooden crates of earth in a dark cellar, lantern light

scenes.narration: That evening, Renfield begs Seward to release him at once.
scenes.visual: Renfield at the bars of his cell, pleading desperately

scenes.narration: He seems calm, sane, and terrified, but Seward refuses.
scenes.visual: Seward turning away from the cell door, troubled

scenes.narration: At night, the men break into Carfax, the ruined house next door.
scenes.visual: Men with lanterns forcing open the oak door of a decaying mansion

scenes.narration: The air inside is thick with the smell of death.
scenes.visual: A dusty chapel interior piled with wooden crates in dim lantern light

scenes.narration: They find the boxes and seal each one with holy bread.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing crumbling a white wafer into an open crate of earth

scenes.narration: Suddenly, the floor comes alive with rats, thousands of them.
scenes.visual: Thousands of rats with glowing eyes swarming across a stone floor

scenes.narration: Arthur whistles, and his terriers drive them off.
scenes.visual: Terrier dogs charging into a swarm of rats

scenes.narration: Back at the asylum, a guard hears a terrible scream.
scenes.visual: A guard running down a dark asylum corridor with a lamp

scenes.narration: Renfield lies broken on the floor of his cell.
scenes.visual: A broken man lying on a cell floor in deep shadow

episodes.title: Unclean
episodes.description: Renfield's dying confession leads the hunters to the Count, and to Mina.

scenes.narration: Last time, Renfield was found dying in his cell.
scenes.visual: Renfield lying on the floor of his cell, Seward kneeling beside him

scenes.narration: With his last breath, he confesses that he let the Count in.
scenes.visual: Renfield whispering to Seward and Van Helsing with his last strength

scenes.narration: And the Count has been visiting Mina.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing's face filled with horror in lamplight

scenes.narration: The men race to the Harkers' room and break down the door.
scenes.visual: Men bursting through a bedroom door at night

scenes.narration: Jonathan lies in a deep trance on the bed.
scenes.visual: Jonathan lying unconscious on a bed in moonlight

scenes.narration: And the Count holds Mina, forcing her to drink his blood.
scenes.visual: Silhouette of the Count gripping a woman by a moonlit window, cloak swirling

scenes.narration: Van Helsing raises the holy bread, and the Count backs away, hissing.
scenes.visual: The Count recoiling and snarling from a raised white wafer

scenes.narration: He turns to mist and vanishes under the door.
scenes.visual: A cloud of pale mist drifting under a door

scenes.narration: Mina covers her face in shame.
scenes.visual: Mina weeping with her hands over her face

scenes.narration: Unclean, she cries. Unclean.
scenes.visual: Close-up of Mina's tear-streaked face in shadow
